status: DRAFT for the owner and counsel. Not approved. Changes nothing while enabled is false.
how_to_enable: Set enabled to true (or run npm run gate:status -- --profile pilot). While enabled is false the full 18-row gate applies exactly as before.
what_it_is: A smaller gate for a CLOSED PILOT only. It defers rows that do not apply while the pilot limits below hold. It is not a launch gate: the full gate must pass before any public launch. Both approvers (one independent) are still required.
limits: At most 3 mandals, invited participants only
Sign-in and one-time codes by SMS or web only: IVR and missed-call channels off
No pilot result shown outside the pilot team until the skew report (row 3) is published
Counsel confirms in writing (row 16) that the pilot dates and the survey publication plan fit the election calendar
Pilot funder named in writing (replaces row 18 for the pilot)

1.why: A threat model not reviewed against the build protects nothing; quick to do

2.why: Real identity data is held in the pilot. May be scoped to identity, OTP, SMS, audit log and key handling

3.why: Required before any pilot RESULT is shown (not before invites). Without it results must not be shown at all

4.why: Phone-to-person data needs real key custody even in a pilot; the dev key provider is refused in production

5.why: Built; attach the diagram and schema check

6.why: A pilot with no tamper-evidence undermines trust in its own results

7.why: SMS cost and abuse caps matter at any scale; pilot-scale run is enough

8.why: Needs notifications, which are off in the pilot

9.why: Full audit with disabled testers is slow
9.condition: Automated accessibility sweep passes and the pilot lead records a manual Telugu screen-reader check by at least 2 testers before invites

10.why: Recorded audio is only for IVR, which is off

11.why: Covers missed-call and IVR; SMS vendor terms are covered by row 7 and the vendor contract
11.condition: IVR and missed-call channels off; SMS provider agreement exists

12.why: Measured on a simulated 2G link already
12.condition: One real low-end phone check recorded by the pilot lead

13.why: Personal data is collected: counsel-approved notices and a real grievance contact are needed

14.why: Erasure and incident reporting must work before real people sign up

15.why: Issue reports can name individuals; takedown and defamation handling must exist

16.why: Election-calendar and survey-publication rules need a counsel memo

17.why: Built; attach the test record. Shared SIMs would otherwise be refused

18.why: A published cost model matters for launch, not a closed pilot
